services.name: strategies.v1.StrategiesService
services.doc:
StrategiesService writes, tests and proposes the caller's trading bots and
 reads them. Bots belong to the caller's main account, and each runs on its
 own subaccount, created when the user deploys it. No call moves money,
 creates a subaccount or deploys a bot: deploying takes the user's MFA and
 wallet signature on the deploy page ProposeDeploy links. StopBot stops a
 bot, which only ever reduces what it does.

 Requests name no account, except the funding subaccount of ProposeDeploy:
 every call acts for the caller's main account, and StopBot also for a
 member of a bot's subaccount whose role may stop it. An
 API key must be scoped to the main account, and its policy must grant the
 call's permission: READ_STRATEGIES for reads, DRAFT_STRATEGIES to create,
 save, rename and delete strategies and test versions, PROPOSE_STRATEGY_DEPLOY to
 propose deploys, STOP_STRATEGIES to stop bots. An API key scoped to a subaccount is refused
 (PERMISSION_DENIED, AUTH_API_KEY_ACCESS_DENIED) even when its policy grants
 the permission. GetStrategyReference, ListStrategyTemplates,
 ListCommunityStrategies and GetCommunityStrategy need no credentials.
 PublishStrategyVersion and UnpublishStrategy take the user's own session:
 publishing makes a strategy's code public, so only the user does it, on
 the website. A session a connected app holds on the user's behalf makes
 the reads with the account:read scope, and creates, saves, renames and
 deletes strategies, tests versions, proposes deploys and stops bots with
 strategies:manage; a call outside the session's scopes refuses it
 (PERMISSION_DENIED, AUTH_SESSION_KIND_NOT_ALLOWED). No connected app
 deploys a bot: deploying takes the user's MFA and wallet signature.
 Every call is safe to retry.

methods.name: CreateStrategy
methods.doc:
CreateStrategy creates a strategy of the caller: blank, from a bot
 template, or as a copy of one of the caller's own versions. A template
 is checked and saved as revision 1, valid or not; a copied version is
 saved as revision 1 as it is. A blank strategy has no revision until its
 first SaveDraftVersion. An account has at most 100 strategies.

 Errors:
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request, or MANIFEST_TOO_LARGE for a
   template.
 - NOT_FOUND: TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND, or VERSION_NOT_FOUND, for another
   account's version as for an unknown or expired one.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: STRATEGY_CAP_REACHED; strategy_cap gives the cap.
 - ALREADY_EXISTS: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; the original strategy stands.
 - UNAVAILABLE: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; retry the same request.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: AUTH_API_KEY_ACCESS_DENIED when the API key's policy
   does not grant DRAFT_STRATEGIES or the key is scoped to a subaccount.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.

methods.name: DeleteStrategy
methods.doc:
DeleteStrategy deletes one strategy of the caller and its revisions. It
 is refused while the strategy is in use: while a bot deployed from it
 hasn't stopped, whether deployed from one of its proposals or running
 one of its revisions' versions, while a deploy proposal of it has
 neither expired, failed nor been deployed, and while its community
 listing is public. Deleting never stops a bot. Proposals of the strategy
 stay, and show no strategy once it is deleted. Its unpublished listing
 stays unpublished, with the versions it published. A version only the
 strategy's revisions kept then expires like any other.

 Errors:
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request.
 - NOT_FOUND: STRATEGY_NOT_FOUND, for another account's strategy as for
   an unknown or already deleted one.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: STRATEGY_IN_USE.
 - UNAVAILABLE: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; retry.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: AUTH_API_KEY_ACCESS_DENIED when the API key's policy
   does not grant DRAFT_STRATEGIES or the key is scoped to a subaccount.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.

methods.name: DeployBot
methods.doc:
DeployBot deploys one deploy proposal of the caller: it checks the
 version again, prepares the bot's subaccount, sets the bot's limits and
 its trading key, and starts the bot. The steps run in the call; once the
 bot's start is recorded, the bot starts without the user.

 Only the user's own session may deploy, and it must be a recently
 MFA-elevated session (MFA_RECENT). API keys and sessions a connected app
 holds on the user's behalf are refused.

 A proposal is deployed at most once. Calling again, after an error, a
 timeout or from another tab, continues the same deploy from where it
 is, and answers its status; it never starts a second bot. A step that
 fails ends the deploy as FAILED, answered as a status, not an error:
 failure says why and what to do.

 Once the bot's limits are set, the call waits up to about 20 seconds for
 the exchange to apply the bot's limits, then answers SETTING_ACCESS:
 call again.

 A deploy that creates a subaccount needs the user's signed
 authorization: request a challenge with CreateSubaccountChallenge, have
 the user sign it, and pass it as subaccount_authorization.

 Errors:
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request.
 - NOT_FOUND: PROPOSAL_NOT_FOUND, for another account's proposal as for
   an unknown one.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: PROPOSAL_EXPIRED, BOT_CAP_REACHED (nothing was
   started), or SUBACCOUNT_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED (the deploy keeps its
   progress).
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: MFA_ELEVATION_REQUIRED; or
   AUTH_SESSION_KIND_NOT_ALLOWED for an API key or a session a connected
   app holds on the user's behalf.
 - UNAVAILABLE: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; retry the same request.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.

methods.name: ExplainStrategy
methods.doc:
ExplainStrategy returns the review summary of a version: what a user

 Errors:

methods.name: ProposeDeploy
methods.doc:
ProposeDeploy records an immutable deploy proposal of one revision of
 the caller's strategy and returns the link to the deploy page, where the
 user deploys it with MFA and a wallet signature. It never deploys,
 creates a subaccount or moves funds. The proposal records the strategy
 and revision it came from, and the revision's version. The version must
 be valid and have passed every behaviour example
 (RunScenarios); its markets must be open to bots; the funding account
 must hold the funding; and the caller must be under their bot cap. A
 finished backtest will be required once backtests are available. A
 proposal expires 24 hours after it is recorded.

 Errors:
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request, SETTINGS_INVALID or
   FUNDING_INVALID.
 - NOT_FOUND: STRATEGY_NOT_FOUND, for another account's strategy as for
   an unknown one; REVISION_NOT_FOUND; or FUNDING_SUBACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: VERSION_INVALID, SCENARIOS_FAILING,
   BACKTEST_MISSING, MARKET_NOT_ALLOWED, INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS or
   BOT_CAP_REACHED.
 - RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: INDICATOR_SETTINGS_LIMIT_REACHED.
 - ALREADY_EXISTS: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; the original proposal stands.
 - UNAVAILABLE: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; retry the same request.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: AUTH_API_KEY_ACCESS_DENIED when the API key's policy
   does not grant PROPOSE_STRATEGY_DEPLOY or the key is scoped to a
   subaccount.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.

methods.name: PublishStrategyVersion
methods.doc:
PublishStrategyVersion publishes one version of one of the caller's
 strategies as the strategy's community listing, with its title,
 description and types: its code, manifest and settings form become
 readable by everyone, its settings shown at their defaults. A strategy
 has one listing; publishing again shows the new version and makes an
 unpublished listing public again. The version must be one of the
 strategy's revisions' versions, valid, with every behaviour example
 passing. Each publish starts the platform backtest of the version
 (CommunityBacktest), whose results the listing shows once it finishes;
 a bot that can't be backtested on candles is published without
 results. An account has at most 20 public listings and publishes at
 most 20 times per UTC day. Publishing shows the author by username.

 Errors:
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request.
 - NOT_FOUND: STRATEGY_NOT_FOUND, for another account's strategy as for
   an unknown one; VERSION_NOT_FOUND when no revision of the strategy
   saved the version.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: VERSION_INVALID; SCENARIOS_FAILING;
   WINDOW_HAS_NO_DATA when the default window holds no market data;
   USERNAME_REQUIRED; LISTING_CAP_REACHED, listing_cap gives the cap;
   PUBLISH_LIMIT_REACHED, retry_after says when the day resets.
 - ALREADY_EXISTS: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; the original publish stands.
 - UNAVAILABLE: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; retry the same request.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: AUTH_SESSION_KIND_NOT_ALLOWED for an API key or a
   session a connected app holds on the user's behalf.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.

RenameStrategy renames one strategy of the caller. Its revisions stay as

methods.name: RunScenarios
methods.doc:
RunScenarios runs a version's behaviour examples against its code and
 records the results. Each market's trading rules (tick, step, minimum
 quantity and minimum notional) are the exchange's when the version first
 runs, unless an example's `observe.markets` says otherwise, and the
 record keeps them: a version always gets the same result, and a new
 version runs on the rules current then.

 Errors:
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request.
 - NOT_FOUND: VERSION_NOT_FOUND.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: VERSION_INVALID, also when a market of the
   version isn't listed on the exchange.
 - RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: SCENARIO_RUN_LIMIT_REACHED; retry after
   retry_after.
 - UNAVAILABLE: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; retry.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: AUTH_API_KEY_ACCESS_DENIED when the API key's policy
   does not grant DRAFT_STRATEGIES or the key is scoped to a subaccount.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.

methods.name: SaveDraftVersion
methods.doc:
SaveDraftVersion checks a bot and saves it as the next revision of one of
 the caller's strategies, which it also renames. The same runtime
 version, manifest and code are always the same version. A bot with
 mistakes is saved too, with valid false and its errors, so it can be
 fixed and saved again. expected_revision must be the strategy's current
 revision, so two writers never overwrite each other. A save whose
 content is the current revision's adds no revision and returns the
 current revision, renaming the strategy if its name is new. Saving a
 version the strategy already keeps never checks it again.

 Errors:
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request, RUNTIME_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED or
   MANIFEST_TOO_LARGE.
 - NOT_FOUND: STRATEGY_NOT_FOUND, for another account's strategy as for
   an unknown one.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: DRAFT_REVISION_CONFLICT; revision_conflict gives
   the current revision and its version. NOTES_REVISION_CONFLICT when
   expected_notes_revision is set and the notes moved past it;
   notes_conflict gives their current revision.
 - ALREADY_EXISTS: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; the original save stands.
 - UNAVAILABLE: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; retry the same request.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: AUTH_API_KEY_ACCESS_DENIED when the API key's policy
   does not grant DRAFT_STRATEGIES or the key is scoped to a subaccount.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.

methods.name: SaveStrategyNotes
methods.doc:
SaveStrategyNotes saves the notes of one strategy of the caller as their
 next revision. expected_notes_revision must be the notes' current
 revision; every revision is kept. Notes equal to the current ones add no
 revision.

 Errors:
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request, including a summary with a line
   break or over 120 characters, or a body over 8192 bytes; its
   buf.validate.Violations detail names the field and the rule.
 - NOT_FOUND: STRATEGY_NOT_FOUND, for another account's strategy as for
   an unknown one.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: NOTES_REVISION_CONFLICT; notes_conflict gives the
   notes' current revision. DRAFT_REVISION_CONFLICT when
   expected_revision is set and the strategy moved past it.
 - ALREADY_EXISTS: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; the original save stands.
 - UNAVAILABLE: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; retry the same request.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: AUTH_API_KEY_ACCESS_DENIED when the API key's policy
   does not grant DRAFT_STRATEGIES or the key is scoped to a subaccount.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.

methods.name: StartBacktest
methods.doc:
StartBacktest starts a backtest of a version. A retry with the same
 idempotency_key and request returns the backtest the first call started.
 Across keys, a request with the same identity (version, effective window,
 settings and initial balances, and the fee rates, platform assumptions and
 simulation versions in force) returns the same backtest rather than
 running again; defaults count as their resolved values (see
 StartBacktestRequest). Every new backtest counts in the attempts of the
 bot's family of versions.

 Errors:
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request, SETTINGS_INVALID or
   FUNDING_INVALID.
 - NOT_FOUND: VERSION_NOT_FOUND.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: VERSION_INVALID, WINDOW_HAS_NO_DATA or
   NOT_BACKTESTABLE.
 - RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: BACKTEST_LIMIT_REACHED, for the daily limit retry
   after retry_after, for the limit on backtests at once retry when one
   finishes; or INDICATOR_SETTINGS_LIMIT_REACHED.
 - ALREADY_EXISTS: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; the original backtest stands.
 - UNAVAILABLE: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; retry the same request.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: AUTH_API_KEY_ACCESS_DENIED when the API key's policy
   does not grant DRAFT_STRATEGIES or the key is scoped to a subaccount.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.

methods.name: StopBot
methods.doc:
StopBot stops a bot: it makes no new decisions. KEEP_ORDERS hands its
 open orders, protective stop-losses included, to its subaccount: they
 stay in the book as the subaccount's own orders, which the bot no longer
 manages. CANCEL_ORDERS cancels them all. Its holdings stay in its
 subaccount. It works in every state but STOPPED: a running or paused bot
 is stopped, and a bot still being deployed is stopped by ending its
 deploy before the bot starts. The stop is recorded before the call answers; the bot then
 reads STOPPING, with no deadline, until its stop is reported complete to
 the service, and STOPPED after. A KEEP_ORDERS stop is complete once the
 bot's in-flight orders are settled: the orders it hands over never hold
 it in STOPPING. A CANCEL_ORDERS stop is complete once every cancelled
 order has ended and its fills are reconciled. On a bot already STOPPING, a call in the same mode
 returns the existing stop, its status as it stands now; one in the
 other mode is BOT_ALREADY_STOPPING. Stopping takes no MFA.

 Who may stop: the bot's owner, with a session or an API key scoped to
 the main account whose policy grants STOP_STRATEGIES; or a member of the
 bot's subaccount, with a session, whose role grants the stop-bots
 permission (owner, admin, trader or leveraged trader; not treasury or
 viewer). An API key scoped to a subaccount, the bot's own included, is
 refused.

 Errors:
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request.
 - NOT_FOUND: BOT_NOT_FOUND, also for a bot the caller may not stop.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: BOT_NOT_RUNNING for a bot already stopped, or
   BOT_ALREADY_STOPPING.
 - ALREADY_EXISTS: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
 - UNAVAILABLE: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; retry.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: AUTH_API_KEY_ACCESS_DENIED when the API key's policy
   does not grant STOP_STRATEGIES or the key is scoped to a subaccount;
   AUTH_SESSION_KIND_NOT_ALLOWED for a session a connected app holds on
   the user's behalf without the strategies:manage scope.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.

methods.name: UnpublishStrategy
methods.doc:
UnpublishStrategy unpublishes one of the caller's community listings: it
 leaves the list, and GetCommunityStrategy answers LISTING_NOT_FOUND. The
 author's next publish makes it public again. Copies other users already
 made stay theirs. Unpublishing an unpublished listing changes nothing.

 Errors:
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: malformed request.
 - NOT_FOUND: LISTING_NOT_FOUND, for another account's listing as for an
   unknown one.
 - UNAVAILABLE: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; retry.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: AUTH_SESSION_KIND_NOT_ALLOWED for an API key or a
   session a connected app holds on the user's behalf.
 - UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid credentials.
